342741.title: The independence-complex conjecture for products of three complete graphs
342741.review_depth: primary body read (conjecture in 1905.06926v1 sec. 2); later paper abstract read
342741.detail: Proved by Antolin Camarena and Carnero Bravo, arXiv:2307.12401 (v1,v2), which computes Ind(K2 x Km x Kn) and proves the Goyal-Shukla-Singh conjecture.

342757.title: Monotonicity of the Robin spectral ratio
342757.review_depth: primary body read (Laugesen 1905.07658v1 Conjecture gapmonotpure); refuting paper abstract read
342757.detail: Disproved by Dai and Sun, arXiv:2609.23544 (2026-09-20): the ratio is strictly increasing on suitable polyhedral domains on any compact positive interval; they also prove the box case.

342782.title: Universality conjecture for normalized collision times
342782.review_depth: statement and source abstract (Deift-Miller-Trogdon 1905.08408v1) screened; no finite mechanism
342782.detail: Universality of a limiting law for normalized stopping times; the class of distributions mu is not sharply specified in the MathDB paraphrase. No finitely checkable route; parked.

342972.title: Existence of weak signed edge-labelings in 3-connected planar graphs
342972.review_depth: primary body read (Kardos-Narboni 1906.05638v1 Conjecture conj:weak and Theorem th:conj_equiv)
342972.detail: The weak signed edge-labeling existence claim is the source Conjecture 2. The same paper proves it equivalent to the Macajova-Raspaud-Skoviera signed 4-colour conjecture and gives a counterexample to that conjecture, so the claim is false by the source itself (zero-credit source-settled).

342976.title: Hliněný–Kwon–Obdržálek–Ordyniak conjecture on rank-depth
342976.review_depth: primary statement read (Kwon-Oum 1906.05753 v1/v2); resolving paper abstract read
342976.detail: Proved by Kwon, McCarty, Oum and Wollan, arXiv:1911.00230 (JCTB 149 (2021) 76-91): large rank-depth iff long path vertex-minor.

343124.title: Bang–Jensen–Thomassé's arc-connectivity conjecture for supereulerian digraphs
343124.review_depth: primary statement read (1907.00853v1 Conjecture conj:BJTh); literature search
343124.detail: Bang-Jensen-Thomasse supereulerian conjecture: famous, open even for alpha=2 per source; no disproof found. No exhaustive digraph search run (labelled digraphs on >=6 vertices exceed the lane caps); parked.

343210.title: The linear-programming improvement conjecture for Paley graph clique bounds
343210.review_depth: primary statement read (Magsino-Mixon-Parshall 1907.05971v1 conj:wewin); literature search
343210.detail: Asks for infinitely many primes with LS(p) < floor(HP(p)); finite computation cannot settle it and no uniform dual-certificate mechanism was found in this pass. Parked.

343244.title: Optimal strong approximation conjecture for the four-square form
343244.detail: The integral four-square optimal strong approximation conjecture appears in 1907.07839v1 but is commented out in v4 (replaced by a function-field conjecture conjectured4); it is also a famous hard conjecture (Sardari). Treated as withdrawn from this source; parked/excluded.

343471.title: The 3-adic valuation pattern conjecture for Morse link numbers
343471.review_depth: primary body read (Gao-Gu 1908.03914 Conj. conj:Morse3adic); exhaustive 3-adic alpha-tree test
343471.detail: Computed L_n mod 3^40 for n<=2200 (weighted Catalan, b(h)=(2h+1)^2). The digit tree of admissible alpha stays alive: alpha = 116 mod 3^5 forced, 27 residues mod 3^8 alive (logs/morse-2.log). No counterexample; no proof mechanism. Parked.

343472.title: Non-algebraicity conjecture for generating functions of non-super-strict partitions
343472.detail: Source proves non-algebraicity only when the two largest parts differ by 1 (Cor. not rational); the general case needs transcendence arguments; parked.

343489.title: Engel et al.'s antichain Hausdorff-measure conjecture
343489.review_depth: primary statement read (Pelekis-Vlasak 1908.04727v1); resolving note abstract read
343489.detail: Proved by Janzer, arXiv:1911.03421 (2019-11-08): antichains in [0,1]^n of (n-1)-dimensional Hausdorff measure n exist for every n.

343506.title: Containment conjecture for cyclic-prime shuffle groups
343506.review_depth: primary statement read (Amarra-Morgan-Praeger 1908.05128v1); resolving paper abstracts read
343506.detail: Marsh, arXiv:2608.12526: H_{k,n} = Sh(C_k,n) is 2-transitive when n is not a power of k and is Alt or Sym(kn) except C_k wr C_{f+1} (n=k^f) and AGL cases for k=4; proves the cyclic conjecture. (Xia-Zhang-Zhang-Zhu 2304.01037 concerns the full shuffle group.)

343628.title: Conjecture on minimally _g-imperfect graphs
343628.review_depth: primary body read (Bujtas-Irsic-Klavzar 1908.09513v1 and author-site revision 2020-01-08, Conjecture 5.4/6.1); exhaustive search beyond source range
343628.detail: Exhaustive twin-aware search reproduces the source Table exactly (perfect graphs 4,11,32,122,536,2754,15752; connected 2,6,19,81,386,2102,12476; minimally imperfect 0,0,2,8,1,1,1 for n=3..9) and extends: 98319 gamma_g-perfect graphs on 10 vertices; minimally gamma_g-imperfect graphs on 10 and 11 vertices are only the antiholes. Complement reformulation (minimal induced members of {no false twins, min degree >=2, orthogonal pair}) recorded; no full proof. Parked.

343646.title: Discreteness conjecture for non-even p-frame energy minimizers
343646.review_depth: primary statement read (Bilyk et al. 1908.10354v1 conj1)
343646.detail: Discreteness of p-frame energy minimizers for non-even p; analytic, open; source proves only empty interior of the support. Parked.

343796.title: Generic polygon invariance conjecture for higher associahedra
343796.review_depth: primary statement read (Galashin-Postnikov-Williams 1909.05435v1, sec. on higher associahedra)
343796.detail: Generic convex n-gon f-vector invariance; verifying beyond n=7 needs exact fiber-polytope/convex-hull computations not feasible under the python-only cap; parked.

344002.title: The uniqueness conjecture for extreme subsets of prime cyclic groups
344002.review_depth: primary body read (Graham 1910.00924v1 Def 1.1, Thm 2.2, equivalence section, Conjecture conjexceptionalZprime); exact certificate; weighing-matrix literature partly read
344002.detail: Two (indeed three) affinely inequivalent 25-element extreme subsets of Z_71, supports of +-1 sequences with autocorrelation 25*delta (CW(71,25)). Exact proof in proof-344002.md; uncompiled Lean draft lean-draft-344002/. MATERIAL RISK: Strassler 1998 (JSPI 73) printed four inequivalent CW(71,25) (body unread, ScienceDirect not accessed); if their supports are inequivalent the contradicting objects were published, the 355525 pattern.

344003.title: The differing-Sidon-constant criterion for extreme subsets
344003.detail: A counterexample needs two inequivalent non-extreme sets with provably equal Sidon constants; exact Sidon constants are non-convex optimization values and no structural equality mechanism was found. Parked.

344004.title: The prime-cardinality frequency conjecture for extreme sets
344004.detail: Qualitative frequency claim ("appear more frequently") without a defined measure; not a precise mathematical statement.

344302.title: The down-up-down-up conjecture for singleton double descent counts
344302.review_depth: primary body read (Zhu 1910.12818 v1/v2 Conj 6.2); Hanni 2011.14360 partial result read; full ordinary proof
344302.detail: Proof for all n: exact convolution identity, meromorphic generating function 1/f with real poles x0(1+3k), interval-certified error bounds for n>200, exact DP for 4<=n<=200. See proof-344302.md and outputs/dd-rigorous-output.txt. Lean not attempted (needs Cauchy estimates and certified transcendental bounds).
